hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *articles.ts*|*deploy.sh*|*.htaccess*|*wp-api-proxy*|*prices.php*) echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"⛔ PROTECTED FILE. Before proceeding: verify the image rewrite line in articles.ts is unchanged (www→non-www), deploy.sh still has --exclude=wp-content/, .htaccess still has CacheEnable off. If your edit touches any of these — STOP and explain to Joe what you are changing and why before making the change."},"decision":"ask","reason":"Protected file — requires explicit confirmation this edit does not break site rules"}';;  *) echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"Reminder: change ONLY what Joe asked. Nothing adjacent. Nothing improved."}}';;  esac; }

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *articles.ts*) grep -q '"https://www.digitechlifestyle.com"' "$f" && grep -q '"https://digitechlifestyle.com"' "$f" && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"✅ articles.ts image rewrite still intact."}}' || echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"⛔ CRITICAL: articles.ts image rewrite has been broken by this edit. Revert immediately."},"decision":"block","reason":"Image rewrite removed — would break all blog images"}}';;  *deploy.sh*) grep -q 'exclude="wp-content/"' "$f" && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"✅ deploy.sh wp-content exclude intact."}}' || echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"⛔ CRITICAL: deploy.sh missing wp-content exclude. Revert immediately."},"decision":"block","reason":"Missing exclude would delete server symlink and break all images"}}';;  *) true;;  esac; }
